title: 第25章 趁你病要你命第26章 谁要杀我
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;噗！
刺客显然没想到辰南还敢反击，一时不慎，被打得吐血倒地，受伤不轻。
他的实力的确很强，但禁术的反噬也的确很可怕。
“苦海种金莲！”
趁此机会，辰南再次施展圣体异象，形成强大的压制，影响刺客的反应。
“神龙摆尾！”
这是真龙九式的第二式。
辰南一脚踹出，犹如神龙摆尾，将轮海境九重的力量全部爆发出去，足有三十万斤的恐怖力量，便是一块钢板都能被踢断。
刺客受到异象影响，来不及躲避，被一脚踹中，横飞出去，撞在墙壁之上，砸出了一个人形凹陷。
趁你病，要你命。
辰南二话不说，再次欺身而进，双手化爪，凌厉如刀，向着刺客扑杀而去。
他知道，自己和刺客的实力差距太大，必须要全力以赴，才有一丝获胜的可能。
而他现在最大的依仗，便是身上的平安符。
这让他能够无视刺客的攻击，立于不败之地。
而刺客多次失手，心神已乱，再加上他受到禁术反噬，此时受伤不轻，实力大跌。
金色气血沸腾，化作一条黄金璀璨的龙形气血，龙威盖世，摄人心魄。
苦海种金莲的异象显化而出，九道本源真气所化的九株金莲，此时灿灿生辉，向着刺客袭击而去。
辰南虽然只有轮海境九重的境界，但他拥有荒古圣体，更是达到了气血极境，凝聚出了龙形气血。
若论战斗力，辰南足以与神宫境三四重的武者媲美。
此时全力爆发，辰南整个人犹如一尊黄金龙神，势不可挡。
刺客大惊失色，迅速出手抵挡。
但他的伤势太重，此时竟然被打得节节败退，吐血连连。
但他终究是归一境九重的强者，即便受了重伤，实力大跌，依旧能够对抗辰南。
嘭！
一声巨响，整座天辰殿都震动了起来。
只见辰南与刺客双双倒飞，落在左右两侧。
而此时刺客的身形终于被逼了出来，显露在辰南面前。
刺客一身黑色夜行衣，脸上也带着黑色面罩，只露出一双冷酷无情的眼睛，令人寒毛倒竖。
“谁派你来的？”
辰南目光如电，死死的盯着黑衣刺客，想要知道他的真实身份，更想知道他背后是否还有其他魔教奸细。
根据紫薇圣主所说，当年父亲遇害，便是被魔教奸细里应外合。

The assassin obviously didn't expect that Chen Nan would dare to fight back. He was accidentally beaten until he vomited blood and fell to the ground, seriously injured.
His strength is indeed very strong, but the backlash of the forbidden technique is indeed terrifying.
"Grow golden lotus from the sea of suffering!"
Taking this opportunity, Chen Nan once again used the Holy Body Vision to form a powerful suppression and affect the assassin's reaction.
"The dragon swings its tail!"
This is the second form of the Nine True Dragon Forms.
Chen Nan kicked out, like a divine dragon waving its tail, exploding all the power of the ninth level of the Wheel Sea Realm. It had a terrifying force of 300,000 kilograms, and even a steel plate could be broken by the kick.
The assassin was affected by the strange phenomenon and had no time to dodge. He was kicked and flew out, hitting the wall and making a human-shaped depression.
"Kill!"
While you are sick, I will kill you.
Without saying a word, Chen Nan stepped forward again, turning his hands into claws, as sharp as a knife, and rushed towards the assassin.
He knew that the strength gap between himself and the assassin was too big, and he had to go all out to have any chance of winning.
And his biggest reliance now is the peace charm on his body.
This allows him to ignore assassin attacks and remain invincible.
The assassin had missed many times and was in a state of confusion. In addition, he had suffered backlash from the forbidden technique. At this time, he was seriously injured and his strength was greatly reduced.
The golden energy and blood boiled, turning into a golden and bright dragon-shaped energy and blood. The dragon was so powerful that it was breathtaking.
The vision of the golden lotus planted in the sea of ​​suffering appeared. The nine golden lotuses transformed from the nine original qi were shining brightly and attacked the assassin.
Although Chen Nan is only at the ninth level of the Wheel and Sea Realm, he possesses the ancient holy body and has reached the ultimate level of Qi and Blood, condensing dragon-shaped Qi and blood.
In terms of combat power, Chen Nan is comparable to the warriors of the third and fourth levels of the Divine Palace Realm.
At this time, Chen Nan exploded with all his strength, and Chen Nan was like a golden dragon god, unstoppable.
The assassin was shocked and quickly moved to resist.
But his injuries were too severe, and he was beaten to the point where he was vomiting blood.
But after all, he is a strong man at the ninth level of the Guiyi Realm. Even if he is seriously injured and his strength is greatly reduced, he can still fight against Chen Nan.
Bang!
There was a loud noise, and the entire Tianchen Palace shook.
Chen Nan and the assassin were seen flying upside down, landing on the left and right sides.
At this time, the assassin's figure was finally forced out and revealed in front of Chen Nan.
The assassin was dressed in black night clothes and had a black mask on his face, revealing only a pair of cold and ruthless eyes, which made people's hair stand on end.
"Who sent you?"
Chen Nan's eyes were like lightning, staring at the black-clothed assassin, wanting to know his true identity, and even more so, wanting to know if there were other spies of the Demon Cult behind him.
According to Holy Lord Ziwei, when his father was killed, it was because of the evil sect's spies who cooperated inside and outside.
